sn48.33:1.4: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimutto hoti.
sn48.33:1.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññāvimuttoti.
